territories.name: Armenia
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2) — the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties; Armenia is a member of the Eurasian Economic Union, not of the European Union. Armenia levies its own value added tax under the Tax Code (Law HO-165-N of 4 October 2016), article 63, at a standard rate of 20%, with a zero rate for exports and international transport (article 65) and exemptions (article 64).
